why_1912_failed: The hidden-map hypothesis was not the complete cause. The renderer accepted any geometry with >=2 points, even when partial live enrichment no longer matched the day's canonical from/to endpoints. reconcileDayEndpointsToRoad could also move itinerary endpoints based on live geometry, which can collapse the next leg.
change: Canonical endpoints are now immutable during reconciliation. Every outward/transfer/return geometry must begin/end at its actual day endpoints or is replaced by guaranteed from-to geometry. Daytrips must include the target or are replaced by base-target-base. Thus a valid Eifel/Sauerland plan always has drawable route segments even if live routing is partial.
